final: WITH status_averages AS (SELECT rfistat AS status, AVG(modindex) AS avg_modindex FROM signals GROUP BY rfistat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) AS value FROM status_averages), kept AS (SELECT status, avg_modindex, avg_modindex - baseline.value AS above_baseline FROM status_averages CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE avg_modindex > baseline.value) SELECT status, avg_modindex, above_baseline, avg_modindex - (SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) FROM kept) AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept
